subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official model/session reconcile-reset surface, and should it report only by default or also clear explicit model, auth, session, and agent pins under scoped flags?
rationale: The requested behavior affects persisted session state, explicit user selections, auth profile routing, agent-level overrides, generated model catalog state, and provider compatibility, so source inspection cannot safely choose the product semantics.

options.title: Dry-run plus opt-in reset
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags for clearing them.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Leave precedence unchanged and improve `status`, doctor, and config validation warnings for shadowed or invalid model refs.

options.title: Auto-clear or reprioritize defaults
options.body: Make default-model changes or resets automatically override existing pins, accepting a compatibility break for durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Dry-run plus opt-in reset
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags for clearing them.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across the inspected model CLI, session utility, status/docs, and provider-routing surfaces.
